name: verdict corpus runner (judge behaviour pins)
description: Replays goal-host's closed, append-only verdict corpus against the live in-process judge entries, publishes the verdictCorpusStatus record the credit hold reads, records a traced verdictCorpusReport, and files one gap per red case. Started by the time-shaped verdict-corpus rhythm and once at goal-host boot. Bootstrap tier: a containment check cannot be earned before it exists, so this template is seeded rather than extracted.

variables.name: trigger
variables.description: What started the run: rhythm or boot.

metadata.traceContract: The goal-host runner records its own trace with this templateId on every run; this template is the catalogue entry that trace names.

tasks.description: Resolve verdictCorpusRun on goal-host: the closed runner replays every case and writes the status, the report and the per-case gaps.
tasks.notes: The task issues the verdictCorpusRun pointer; it consumes no pool impulse, so it declares no inputShapes (a declared input with no impulse in the pool fires preBinding and a missing_input_shapes gap).
